outcome: Detection of critical and cyanotic congenital heart disease (CHD)
cohort: 3,846 term neonates born between 2008 and 2011 with normal physical examinations
finding: Pulse oximetry screening on the first day of life, particularly within 8-24 hours, is a useful tool for the early detection of critical and cyanotic CHD in asymptomatic newborns.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was recorded as data in this study examining the use of pulse oximetry to detect congenital heart disease in newborns, but no findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
